blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Much of corporate support for Philippine education has long come in tangible forms, such as chairs, learning materials, computers and other equipment schools can readily put to use. The need for material support is evident in schools across the country, many of which still contend with shortages in basic facilities and equipment.
